name: tinymvc/laravel-supports
description: A collection of support classes and functions of Laravel, fine-tuned for TinyMVC/Spark.

suggest.league/commonmark: Required to use Str::markdown() and Stringable::markdown() (^2.6).
suggest.voku/portable-ascii: Required for Str::ascii(), Str::slug(), Str::isAscii(), and ASCII validation rules (^2.0).
suggest.doctrine/inflector: Required to use Str::plural() and Stringable::plural() (^2.0).
